basics.name: Hiruna Vishwamith
basics.label: FPGA Design Engineer · Computer Architecture & AI Acceleration
basics.summary: Electronics & Telecommunications engineer working at the intersection of computer architecture, reconfigurable computing, and AI acceleration. I design and verify processors and accelerators from RTL to FPGA, and map modern AI models onto custom hardware. 5 peer-reviewed publications (IEEE HPEC, CHEP, ISARC, INTCEC).

projects.name: Chiron — Out-of-Order RISC-V Processor
projects.summary: A fully-verified out-of-order RV64IMA RISC-V core in Chisel with register renaming, an 8-entry issue queue, a 16-entry reorder buffer, TAGE branch prediction, and a non-blocking coherent cache hierarchy. Verified instruction-by-instruction in lock-step against a golden C++ model; passes all 84 RISC-V ISA tests and boots Linux.

projects.name: Cache-Coherent, Out-of-Order Multicore RISC-V CPU
projects.summary: Led the design of an end-to-end out-of-order, cache-coherent multicore RISC-V processor taken from RTL to FPGA, capable of running bare-metal C programs and booting Linux in multicore mode. Included an Instruction Fetch Unit with a TAGE branch predictor and a multi-threading benchmark suite.

projects.name: ASTRA — LEO Satellite Network Simulator
projects.summary: A physics-accurate Low Earth Orbit constellation simulator in pure C11 with a hand-rolled OpenGL renderer. Couples real Kepler orbital mechanics to per-timestep routing (Dijkstra, distance-vector); validated to machine precision (3e-12 km orbital parity, bit-exact routing over 30k+ paths) and ThreadSanitizer-clean.

projects.name: Parameterized SIMD Processor for Matrix Operations
projects.summary: A fully parameterized SIMD processor with a custom ISA for matrix multiplication, addition, and subtraction, built on a 4-stage pipeline in Verilog and deployed on a ZYBO Z7 FPGA with AXI/DMA integration.
